objects.name: Analytic 2151
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process opening Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol master connections to multiple field device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, from a host that is not the authorized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) server. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state change. Suppress legitimate redundancy/failover, hot-standby promotion, commissioning, and approved engineering master activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): connect syscalls show a host outside the approved SCADA/master set opening ICS-protocol connections to multiple field devices

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP/identity allowlist of legitimate master/control server systems.
Inventory of authorized station/master addresses for protocols using logical addressing distinct from IP.
Time window within which command traffic to multiple devices from a single unrecognized source is considered a coordinated rogue master event.
